Hi Alex —

Great to talk earlier. Quick recap and a couple of concrete next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (30 min discovery)
- Primary use: document ingestion + question answering for internal knowledge base
- Expected peak load: roughly ~200–300 inference QPS during batch jobs; interactive traffic ~20–40 QPS
- Latency target: 95th < 250ms for interactive flows; batch can be higher
- Data constraints: PHI may be present in a subset of documents — need Private deployment discussion for compliance

Next steps / ask
1) Book a 60-minute technical deep-dive + dedicated sizing session (we'll bring SE + infra).
2) Please provide any load forecasts and a short sample payload (schema or small sample) ahead of the call.
3) We'll run through a short intake worksheet so we can size a dedicated GPU pool and recommend batching/quantization options.

Proposed windows (PT) — pick one or suggest alternatives:
- Tue Jul 13, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Jul 14, 08:00–09:00 PT

I've attached a short sizing worksheet to make the call efficient (redwood-sizing-worksheet.xlsx). If either slot works, reply with preferred time and we'll lock a calendar invite.

Thanks — cc'ing Marissa (solutions) to run the intake and Priyom (perf) for the sizing run.

Ben Carter
